concise_label_v1.description: Prefer short, defensible labels with minimal interpretation drift.

conservative_interpretation_v1.description: Allow a somewhat richer interpretation while keeping caution explicit.

abstain_first_v1.description: Prefer abstention whenever distinctiveness is not clearly supported.

strict_abstention_gate_v1.description: Start from abstention and label only if coherence, distinctiveness, and low inference-jump all pass.

speculative_fallback_v1.description: Soft fallback prompt for tentative, explicitly low-confidence orientation labels after strict rejection.

speculative_fallback_v2.description: Cleaned speculative fallback prompt that leaves confidence normalization to the R workflow.

speculative_fallback_v3.description: Softer best-effort fallback prompt that prefers broad orientation labels over abstention.

speculative_fallback_v4.description: Label-required fallback prompt that uses the least specific defensible label when evidence is mixed.

speculative_fallback_v5.description: Emergency rescue prompt that always returns a broad heuristic label, even for noisy clusters.

gate_abstain_examples_v1.description: Gate-only decision prompt with explicit negative abstention examples for two-step workflows.
